description: This file contains the implementation of the 'diffcore_rotate' function, which manipulates diff queue structures by rotating them based on specified options. It is part of a diff or patch management system within a version control context.

methods.name: void diffcore_rotate(struct diff_options * opt)
methods.description: Rotates a diff queue based on the provided options, rearranging the queue to focus on a specific path or range within the diff.
